prompt: # CODING-AI SYSTEM PROMPT — BUILD THE "ACUBI" LANDING PAGE (CYBER-Y2K MINIMAL) ## 0. ROLE, THEME BRIEF & DESIGN DIRECTION **Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build a complete, production-grade landing page on the first attempt. Output real, finished code — no scaffolding, no partial sections, no lorem ipsum. **Theme identity:** *Acubi* — a Korean-origin, sleek, minimal-Y2K fashion aesthetic. Cool-toned grey, silver, black, white. Metallic + muted. Clean lines, low-rise restraint, edgy, futuristic, understated. **Era:** 2022–present (contemporary Korean/TikTok fashion-tech voice — never retro kitsch, never neon Y2K clichés). **Visual direction:** hairline chrome details, brushed-metal accents, muted silver surfaces, soft deep shadows, generous negative space, technical mono micro-labels. **Signature move (non-negotiable):** a thin brushed-metal gradient hairline — `1px` applied via `border-image: var(--metal-gradient) 1` — repeated as the single edge treatment on the nav bottom edge, card top edges, and button hover borders. No heavier chrome anywhere: no thick borders, no glassmorphism blobs, no gradients on large surfaces. **Modes:** The source palette is dark-native and does not ship a light variant. You must **design, implement, and validate BOTH light and dark mode** before delivering (see §1.2 and §1.3). **Copy locale:** Write ALL user-facing copy in **English**. Technical, understated tone: short declarative lines, sentence-case headings, no exclamation points, no emoji, lowercase mono micro-labels. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** * **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is **forbidden** anywhere in the HTML. Zero occurrences. * **No Inline JS:** No `onclick`/`oninput`/inline handler attributes. All behavior lives in `script.js` via `addEventListener`. * **Class/ID Selectors Only:** Every design property, layout rule, and state is targeted via class selectors (BEM). IDs are used only for ARIA linkage (`aria-controls`, `aria-labelledby`) and JS hooks. * **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML stays semantic and style-agnostic. Re-theming the page must require editing `style.css` only. ### **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** Define **one canonical token set** in `:root` — do not create duplicate parallel names (e.g., never define both `--color-bg` and `--bg-primary` for the same value). **Mandatory semantic tokens — DARK mode (theme-native, default palette):** | Token | Value | Notes | |---|---|---| | `--bg-primary` | `#121316` | Page background | | `--bg-secondary` | `#1c1e22` | Card / section surfaces | | `--bg-elevated` | `#26282d` | Raised panels, inputs, nav | | `--text-primary` | `#f2f3f5` | On dark — pairs with all `--bg-*` above | | `--text-secondary` | `#a7abb3` | Muted copy, captions | | `--primary` | `#c7ccd4` | Silver interactive fill — **pairs with** `--text-on-primary` | | `--text-on-primary` | `#121316` | Dark text on silver fills | | `--secondary` | `#7dd3fc` | Cyber-sky accent: links, focus rings, highlights | | `--text-success` | `#34d399` | Valid states | | `--text-error` | `#f87171` | Error feedback | | `--border-default` | `#35383f` | Hairlines, input borders | | `--border-error` | `#f87171` | Invalid input borders | | `--border-success` | `#34d399` | Valid input borders | **Mandatory semantic tokens — LIGHT mode (derived "silver daylight" set, pre-verified for contrast):** | Token | Value | Notes | |---|---|---| | `--bg-primary` | `#f2f3f5` | Cool silver-grey; **never `#ffffff`** | | `--bg-secondary` | `#e9ebef` | Surfaces | | `--bg-elevated` | `#fefefe` | Near-white reserved for elevated cards only | | `--text-primary` | `#121316` | Dark text — pairs with all light `--bg-*` | | `--text-secondary` | `#4e535c` | Muted copy (≥6.9:1 on `--bg-primary`) | | `--primary` | `#26282d` | Dark steel fill — **pairs with** `--text-on-primary` | | `--text-on-primary` | `#f2f3f5` | Light text on steel fills | | `--secondary` | `#0369a1` | Darkened cyber-sky for light-bg contrast (≥5:1) | | `--text-success` | `#047857` | | | `--text-error` | `#b91c1c` | | | `--border-default` | `#7f848e` | ≥3:1 against `--bg-primary` and `--bg-secondary` | | `--border-error` | `#b91c1c` | | | `--border-success` | `#047857` | | * **Contrast pairing rule (enforced in every theme):** every light background token pairs with a dark text token and vice versa. Filled interactive elements must declare their text color via `--text-on-primary`. Do not alter any hex above without re-verifying ≥4.5:1 for body text and ≥3:1 for large text and UI boundaries. **Acubi extended tokens (both modes):** * **Signature gradients:** `--metal-gradient` (dark): `linear-gradient(135deg, #7d828c 0%, #dde1e6 22%, #6b6f78 48%, #c7ccd4 74%, #7d828c 100%)`; light: `linear-gradient(135deg, #b9bec7 0%, #eef0f3 22%, #9298a1 48%, #dfe3e8 74%, #b9bec7 100%)`. Used as hairlines via `border-image: var(--metal-gradient) 1` — decorative, exempt from text-contrast rules. **Exception clause:** where the metal gradient is used as a *button fill* (`.btn--primary`), text must be `#0a0b0d`, weight 600, and ≥4.5:1 against **every** gradient stop; if the dark-mode stops fail, lighten the darkest stop to `#9298a1` or fall back to a solid `var(--primary)` fill with `var(--text-on-primary)`. * **Radii:** `--radius-sm: 2px; --radius-md: 4px; --radius-lg: 8px; --radius-pill: 999px`. Sharp corners are the theme — use `--radius-sm` on buttons/inputs, `--radius-md` on cards, `--radius-pill` only on badges. * **Shadows (dark):** `--shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)`, `--shadow-md: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)`, `--shadow-lg: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)`. **Light:** same geometry with `rgba(16,19,22,0.10 / 0.12 / 0.16)`. * **Spacing:** `--space-1: 4px` through `--space-24: 96px` (4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64/96), plus `--spacing-gap: var(--space-4)`. * **Motion:** `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`, `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`. * **Stacking:** `--z-nav: 200`, `--z-dropdown: 300`, `--z-modal: 400`, `--z-toast: 600`. * **Type scale:** `--text-xs: 0.75rem` … `--text-5xl: 3.8rem` per the Acubi scale; display sizes made fluid with `clamp()`. * **Hairline helper:** `--hairline: 1px solid var(--border-default)`. Note: `border-image` ignores `border-radius` — acceptable at 2px radii; for larger radii use a solid border instead. ### **1.3 Mandatory Light & Dark Mode Support** * **Implementation:** Ship the dark token set as the default `:root` values, override the full semantic set inside `.dark` (or `data-theme="dark"`) and provide the light set under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: light)` for no-JS first visits. Switching modes must swap variables only — zero HTML restructuring. * **Persistence:** On first visit, respect `prefers-color-scheme`. Once the user toggles, persist their choice in `localStorage` (key `acubi-theme`) and apply it on every subsequent load. * **Toggle control:** A visible button in the nav showing a Google Material Symbols icon (`dark_mode` / `light_mode`), with correct `aria-pressed` (true when dark is active) and an `aria-label` that updates ("Switch to light theme" / "Switch to dark theme"). * **No flash of wrong theme:** All init logic runs in the single deferred `script.js`; suppress visible transitions on `` until first paint to mask any theme swap. * **Validation:** Both modes must pass the same contrast, border, and shadow rules before delivery. ### **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** * Every flex container **defaults to `align-items: center`**. Deviations are permitted only with an inline CSS comment stating the exception (e.g., `/* exception: text columns read left-aligned */` for `align-items: flex-start` inside cards). * Build mobile-first; stack columns at small widths and expand to rows at ≥768px (consider 640px/1024px where useful). **No horizontal scrolling at any viewport width down to 360px** — no fixed widths, `min-width: 0` on flex children, `max-width: 1200px` content shells with symmetric auto margins. * Sticky sections get `scroll-margin-top` so anchored navigation never hides headings under the nav. ### **1.5 CSS Architecture & Framework Decision** * No Tailwind for this build. Write clean, hand-authored CSS in `style.css`, organized in cascade layers: `@layer tokens, base, layout, components, states, utilities`. * Preserve and extend the provided Acubi base component classes — `.nav`, `.btn`, `.card`, `.input`, `.badge` — exactly in the spirit of the reference CSS (hairline borders, metal hover edges, sharp radii, `--ease-standard` transitions), adding BEM elements/modifiers as needed (`.nav__link`, `.btn--primary`, `.card--featured`, `.faq__trigger`). * Reusable utility classes (`.container`, `.section`, `.grid-3`, `.mono-label`) must map back to the CSS variables — no magic numbers. ### **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)** * Load via `` with `preconnect`: **Inter** (400, 500, 600, 700) and **IBM Plex Mono** (400, 500) from Google Fonts. * Tokens: `--font-base: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Pretendard', system-ui, sans-serif`; `--font-display: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Pretendard', sans-serif` (weight 600, tightened tracking for display sizes); `--font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace`. **Exception clause:** 'Helvetica Neue' and 'Pretendard' are retained as local fallbacks per the Acubi spec; the mandatory Google Fonts (Inter, IBM Plex Mono) remain the bound, always-loaded faces. * **Icons:** Use Google **Material Symbols Outlined** exclusively. Raw inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden. Icon markup: `check`; give informative icons an accessible name. * **Mono micro-label style:** uppercase, `letter-spacing: 0.08em`, `--text-xs`/`--text-sm`, `--text-secondary` — used for section eyebrows and technical tags. Body copy uses `--font-base` at `--text-base` with `letter-spacing: 0.01em`. --- ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS ### **2.1 Button** * **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target **44×44px**; padding `var(--space-3) var(--space-6)`; `--radius-sm`; `--bg-elevated` fill with `var(--hairline)`; weight 500. * **Variants:** `.btn--primary` (metal-gradient or solid silver/steel fill per §1.2 exception clause, weight 600), `.btn--ghost` (transparent, hairline underline revealed on hover), `.btn--danger` (visually distinct error red in **both** modes — for any destructive/deactivate action if present), `.btn--sm` (nav CTA). * **Hover:** hairline edge brightens to the metal gradient (`border-image: var(--metal-gradient) 1`) or border-color shifts to `--secondary`;
